verdict.rationale: Google's own GitHub project publishes open-source implementations of the passcode generators for several mobile platforms, plus a PAM module. The app can also run fully local without a Google account and generate codes offline. However, sync is only documented through Google Accounts, and nothing shows a self-hostable sync or backend, or that the current shipped app can be built and run from source. Missing for 10: a self-hostable sync/backup server, documentation for building or deploying the core product yourself, confirmation that the shipped app matches the open-source code, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The Google Authenticator project includes implementations of one-time passcode generators for several mobile platforms.
When you first open the app, tap Use without an account.
You can still generate codes without an internet connection or mobile service.
